_comment: Aliases for the institution tier lookups (src/shortlisting/tiers/institutions.py): abbreviations, short forms and former names -> the name as written in NIRF (or in config/institution_global_seed.json). 'patterns' expand the usual short forms of the national institute systems ('IIT <city>' -> 'Indian Institute of Technology <city>'); an entry in 'aliases' wins over a pattern. 'city_synonyms' are tried both ways. 'abbreviations' work like config/venue_abbreviations.json. A small editable seed list for India.
